title: Alpanian culture
description: Adds the culture of southern Dagestan
body:
![✨✨✨](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bf87f12e8f71285ab74fad64dc56cb1ef8b2b35d_0.webp)
Description: Experience the rich heritage of Southern Dagestan. This mod introduces authentic cultural elements from the Lezgin, Tabasaran, and other local traditions, featuring unique food mechanics and iconic traditional attire.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

👔Apparel \
Papakha \
Type: Headgear \
Description: A legendary Caucasian hat handcrafted from sheepskin. It represents dignity, honor, and the spirit of the mountains. \
Gameplay Note: Purely cosmetic. It doesn't offer physical protection, but it makes you look like a true mountain leader. As the saying goes: "If the head is intact, the Papakha must be on it."

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

👨🏻‍🍳Food & Cuisine \
Afar \
Type: Traditional Flatbread \
Special Mechanic: Stackable Layers \
Description: Thin dough filled with mountain herbs or seasoned meat. \
Ability: You can stack Afar on top of another Afar to create a multi-layered meal. Each added layer increases the saturation and hunger restoration points. The more you stack, the better the feast!

Tsken \
Type: Hearty Meat Pie \
Special Mechanic: Power at a Price \
Description: A famous, heavy Lezgin pie packed with layers of meat, potatoes, and spices. It is the ultimate fuel for a warrior. \
Effects: \
Highland Might: Grants a significant Strength buff. \
Full Stomach: Due to its richness, it applies a temporary Slowness effect.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

In-Game Tooltips (Short): \
Papakha: "A symbol of honor. Just a very handsome hat!" \
Afar: "Layering allowed! Place on top of another Afar to increase stats." \
Tsken: "The weight of tradition. Provides great Strength but slows you down."

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Thank you for playing with this mod✨
